generators.name: RFdiffusion MPNN binder design
generators.description: Cycle RFdiffusion3 backbone generation and ProteinMPNN sequence design against a fixed target, conditioned on Boltz-2 folds between cycles.

evidence.quote: Topology: cycling — RFdiffusion → MPNN → fold → score → repeat.

constraints.name: structure ipTM filter
constraints.description: Require predicted binder-target interface confidence above threshold.

constraints.name: Boltz2 binding strength
constraints.description: Score predicted binding strength of the designed binder against the target.

constraints.name: ESM-2 naturalness
constraints.description: Penalize unnatural binder sequences during cycling.

constraints.name: protein length range
constraints.description: Keep binder within the configured mini-protein length window.

optimizers.name: cycling design refinement
optimizers.description: Alternate Boltz-2 folding with ProteinMPNN redesign; cycle 1 bootstraps from RFdiffusion3+MPNN.

model_dependencies.name: RFdiffusion3
model_dependencies.purpose: Binder backbone generation on cycle bootstrap

model_dependencies.name: Boltz-2
model_dependencies.purpose: Structure prediction and binding scoring between cycles

steps.operation: RFdiffusion3 + MPNN initial binder against target
Boltz-2 fold binder-target complex and score ipTM / affinity
ProteinMPNN redesign binder chain from folded complex

assumptions: Cycle 1 bootstraps via RFdiffusion3+MPNN inside the cycling conditioning function; later cycles use Boltz-2 folds.
Shares CXCR4 chain A from PDB 4RWS with gpcr-cxcr4-miniprotein and freebindcraft-binder benchmarks.
Partial RFdiffusion diffusion is not modeled; cycling repeats MPNN refinement on Boltz-2-conditioned complexes.
unknowns: True multi-cycle partial diffusion from the RFdiffusion3 paper is not reproduced.
Wet-lab binding validation is out of scope.
